---
title: "About"
---

Weekly data analyses and visualizations for the [#TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday) social data project, hosted by the R4DS Community.

Each week a new dataset is released. This site collects my explorations for 2026, built with R and Quarto.

## Author

**Daniel B. Mason (Cooper)**

- GitHub: [thedbcooper](https://github.com/thedbcooper)

## Tech Stack

- **Language**: R
- **Visualization**: ggplot2
- **Data Wrangling**: dplyr, tidyr
- **Reporting**: Quarto
- **Reproducibility**: per-week `renv` lockfiles
